description:
From the moment she turns twenty-nine, Naryeong is plagued by one misfortune after another—from death threats to a car accident. Her streak of bad luck eventually culminates in her being sexually harassed by ghosts. Then Taeheon appears before her as though brought by fate and declares that he will help her. The talisman he gives her protects her body from the ghosts, but for some reason, it also begins to make her burn with desire… 

“What should I do for you?”    

“Please… scratch me on the inside too. All the way to the deepest part…”
